description: Short, practical pages by Coach Moshiur for a leader with a problem today ("someone on my team keeps missing deadlines", "I have to give hard feedback", "I am exhausted and still have to lead"). Give a few words of the problem as query to search; leave query out to list the situations (of one group, or all). Each line has the title, a one-sentence summary, the key for get_situation and the link.

group.description: Only this group: people (my people), boss_peers (my boss and peers), self (myself), business (my business), home_community (home and community). Optional.

language.description: Language: en English, bn Bangla, ar Arabic, ur Urdu, zh Chinese. Default en.

query.description: The problem in a few words, in the chosen language. Optional.

name: find_situations
title: What's hard right now? Find a situation
